title: Emitted size selection
responsibility: Names per-target artifact limits and selects build measurements that qualify for those frozen limits.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: Target name to append to the artifact-bytes ledger key.

inputs.name: emittedSizes.measurements
inputs.description: Measurements with metric and optional target, profile and workload fields; the helper filters without changing entries.

outputs.name: emittedMetric
outputs.description: The metric name artifact-bytes used for emitted output sizes.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: Ledger key artifact-bytes: followed by the supplied target.

outputs.name: emittedSizes
outputs.description: Entries whose metric is artifact-bytes, target is defined, and profile and workload are both absent or empty. Benchmark sizes with a profile or workload are excluded; original order and objects are preserved.
